title: Go through all levels and Auto Rebirth
features:
Simple Script to teleport you through all the stages and get a automatic rebirth.

Just edit the "LoopFor" number if you wanna go through more times :p
script:
local Checkpoints = game:GetService("Workspace"):WaitForChild("Checkpoints")
local CheckpointNum = #Checkpoints:GetChildren()

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Char = player.Character
local HRP = Char.HumanoidRootPart

--- 


local LoopFor = 50 -- Change this to however many times you want to go through.


----


-- Below this is the script, don't edit unless you know what you're doing.


for i = 0, LoopFor, 1 do


for i = 0, CheckpointNum, 1 do
wait()
if i ~= 52 then
HRP.CFrame = Checkpoints[i].CFrame
else
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("RebirthEvent"):FireServer()
end
print(i)
end

end
